about.title: About the Sun & Moon set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Sun & Moon is a Sun & Moon expansion released on 3 February 2017. It has 172 cards: 149 in the main set and 23 secret rares. There are also 126 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 149 main set cards), the Master set (275 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 298 cards, adding the 23 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
